links.comparator_used: Basic prompt without the CFS definition (instruction-tuned prompt bundled the CFS definition with a directive for accurate responses and temperature control, so the effect is not isolated)
links.outcome: Consistency and inter-rater reliability of CFS scoring by GPT-3.5-turbo across seven scenarios
links.effect: Score distributions differed significantly between basic and instruction-tuned prompts in 5 of 7 scenarios; instruction-tuned prompt Fleiss' Kappa 0.887 with consistent responses in all scenarios; median scores within 1 point of human raters
links.tradeoff: Scoring was difficult in scenarios with less explicit ADL information, and the LLM may overestimate frailty when less ADL information is given.
links.quote: The instruction-tuned prompt showed high inter-rater reliability (Fleiss' Kappa of 0.887) and produced consistent responses in all scenarios.

design_hint: instruction-tuned prompt guardrails (CFS definition, accuracy directive, temperature control)
